trigger.finding: The provisional key name_anchor_discordance could be misread as disagreement between selected entity identities, while the implementation compares two preferred-option correctness indicators.
trigger.evidence_state: No v4 prompt was tokenized, no server was launched, no model output or human label existed, and no protected condition mapping was accessed.

effective_endpoint.name: preferred_name_anchor_indicator_discordance
effective_endpoint.definition: Absolute disagreement between preferred_current_name_selection and preferred_current_anchor_selection; equivalently 1 when exactly one of those two binary correctness indicators equals 1, otherwise 0.
not_measured: Whether independently parsed canonical-name and opaque-anchor channels select two different nonpreferred/current entities.
effective_endpoint.separate_identity_diagnostic: label_anchor_name_consistency remains the categorical CONSISTENT/CONFLICT/MULTIPLE/NONE identity diagnostic.

scope: Only the effective endpoint key and its exact construct are clarified. No cases, prompts, arms, order, coefficients, thresholds, stopping rules, resource limits, or outcomes changed.
execution_gate: The controller, tests, future authorization, frozen manifest, audit, and analysis must bind this clarification by SHA-256.
